AC-02: validate protected requirement — The API issues a session only when `parallax.qa.ai@gmail.com` exists in `authorized_users`, is active, and already has a bound Google auth user ID.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — Neither repository code nor workflow configuration stores the QA password, refresh token, Supabase service-role key, Parallax access token, or another long-lived QA credential.
AC-04: validate protected requirement — Google login, hidden human QA password fallback, session expiry, logout, owner/member access and protected-route behavior remain unchanged.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — The dedicated workflow can establish a production Parallax session and invoke the existing protected autonomous endpoint for run `af617b0b-5297-427c-a40d-90d58f59a20a` without owner browser interaction.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — A replay passes only if durable run evidence advances beyond the former PLAN revision-1 missing-static-target failure without `source_bootstrap_failed` / `ProductionDeliveryConfigurationError`; provider/runtime evidence stays within the existing REVIEW/Preview authority ceiling.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Forged, malformed, expired, not-yet-valid, wrong-audience, wrong-repository, wrong-ref, wrong-workflow, wrong-event, self-hosted-runner, and JWKS-verification failures produce no Parallax session and cannot fall back to another authentication method.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — If the dedicated QA allowlist row is missing, revoked, inactive, or no longer Google-bound, the machine assertion is denied even when the GitHub Actions OIDC assertion itself is valid.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — The GitHub workflow run provides a durable provider-side run identity and bounded execution evidence while raw OIDC tokens, cookies, passwords, refresh tokens, and provider credentials remain absent from committed artifacts and application logs.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — The exact qualified API source is deployed READY before the workflow runs; the automation session endpoint succeeds only from the merged trusted workflow; ordinary Google and hidden human QA login behavior remain unchanged; post-replay API/runtime errors and durable run state are inspected before any completion claim or authoritative-record update.
